reuse.why: Follows the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard pattern and calls it before it, but does not fold the closed check into the account lookup each link function already performs, so it re-reads the row.

duplication.why: One new guard used by all six providers; it repeats the 'Account with ID ... not found' lookup that each link function still does further down.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guard, where the link handlers live.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and named, though six separate call sites must be remembered for any new provider and the double lookup is slightly redundant.

one_place.where: ensureAccountCanBeLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account handlers
